speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin investigating your chronic joint pain, please tell me your age and which specific joints are affected. Also, does the pain worsen with activity or at rest?

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old male. The patient presents with pain in his left great toe, hips, and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest. He reports that the symptoms have progressively gotten worse over the past several years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis (left first MTP joint, hips, and knees).

The progressive worsening of your joint pain over several years, combined with the mechanical pattern of pain that worsens with activity and improves with rest, is highly characteristic of osteoarthritis. I will now request X-rays of your left foot, hips, and knees to confirm joint space narrowing and osteophyte formation.

REQUEST IMAGES: Left_foot_Xray, Hips_Xray, Knees_Xray
